newsitem.title: ITALY: Consob okays Autostrade sale survey.
newsitem.headline: Consob okays Autostrade sale survey.

text.p: Italy's stock market authority Consob has given its go-ahead to state industrial holding IRI to carry out a market survey ahead of the planned privatisation of motorway operator Autostrade.
The announcement was in Consob's weekly bulletin published on Monday. IRI's survey is aimed at "gathering useful information about groups to be chosen as investors," Consob's note said.
The procedure is a normal step ahead of publishing a privatisation prospectus.
Italy plans to make a public sale offer of Autostrade by this summer.
